_README: Azure Pipelines Task skeleton committed in the CLI repo for review and to unblock the manifest test (test/unit/ado-task-manifest.test.ts). The published copy will live in the Visual Studio Marketplace once a signing cert is provisioned (publish step T11 is an external human gate that this repo acknowledges as out-of-scope). The `_README` field is intentionally not part of the `tfx-cli validate` contract and is ignored by Marketplace ingestion; it documents the file's provenance for downstream reviewers.
name: UmActuallyReview
description: Run umactually as an Azure Pipelines Task — Node.js 24 setup, npm install of the CLI, first-run secret bootstrap, live PR review, and verdict output for branch protection.
helpMarkDown: See [docs/install-action.md](../docs/install-action.md) for the canonical install reference and [docs/onboarding/github-marketplace.md](../docs/onboarding/github-marketplace.md) for the Marketplace listing copy. Required repository secrets: `UMACTUALLY_API_URL` and `UMACTUALLY_API_KEY`. The task emits the typed exit code `UMACTUALLY_ERR_SECRET_BOOTSTRAP` (3) when the secrets are absent on an opening/reopening PR.
author: Josiah Siegel

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: CLI version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of the `umactually` CLI to install via `npm install -g`. Default `__UMACTUALLY_VERSION__` is the substitution point the `umactually init` wizard uses to track the CLI release; pin a specific tag (e.g. `0.8.2`) to disable auto-update.

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: Provider API base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: API base URL for the configured provider family. Forwarded to the CLI as `UMACTUALLY_API_URL`. Default reads the pipeline variable `UMACTUALLY_API_URL`; only override when the provider's base URL differs from the variable.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: Provider API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provider API key. Forwarded to the CLI as `UMACTUALLY_API_KEY`. Default reads the pipeline variable `UMACTUALLY_API_KEY`. Never place the credential in YAML literals or command arguments.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: Provider family
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provider family. One of `openai-compatible`, `anthropic`, or `copilot`. Default `openai-compatible` — the wizard's pick for the most common operator profile.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Provider model
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provider-specific model identifier (optional). Empty string = let the provider pick its default model.

inputs.name: configPath
inputs.label: Config path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the committed `umactually.review.json` policy file (schemaVersion 1). Default `./umactually.review.json` — the wizard's default path.

inputs.name: outputArtifact
inputs.label: Output artifact path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path the CLI writes the review artifact to. Default `umactually-review.json`.

inputs.name: skipDraft
inputs.label: Skip draft threads
inputs.helpMarkDown: When `true`, the CLI skips re-reviewing files whose inline threads haven't changed since the last run. Default `true` matches the wizard's default (cost-aware incremental review).

inputs.name: pathsIgnore
inputs.label: Paths to ignore
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated gitignore-style globs the CLI excludes from review. Default excludes Markdown docs and lock files.

outputVariables.name: verdict
outputVariables.description: Success/failure verdict for required status checks. `success` when the review posted without a parse-fail sentinel; `failure` otherwise.

outputVariables.name: inlineThreadCount
outputVariables.description: Number of inline review threads posted to the PR. Zero is a successful clean review.

outputVariables.name: reviewId
outputVariables.description: Opaque run identifier (request id) emitted by the CLI in the review artifact's `metadata.requestId` field.
